heard: A dwarf planet is spinning into a football shape. While Earth takes 24 hours to rotate, Big Jupiter takes 10. But the frozen world Halmea completes a day in under 4 hours. That is one of the fastest spins in the solar system. Centrifugal force has stretched its rock and ice into a lopsided egg. Astronomers found something even more bizarre near the object in 2017. Halmea is the first of its kind found with its own ring system. It really is a dwarf planet spinning into a football shape.
